## What is CAKIE?

Don't just tell your AI. Show it. Record your screen and explain what matters.
CAKIE turns what you say and show into a clear prompt with the right screenshots attached.

Show it. Then paste it.

1. Record: Talk through what's on your screen as if a teammate were sitting next to you. Just hit record and explain what you mean. Point or draw to highlight the details, or let AI find the screenshots that match what you're saying.
2. Paste: CAKIE turns your recording into a prompt that connects your words to what was on screen. Click Copy Prompt, then paste it into your AI agent. Your instructions and the context behind them, ready to go.

Give your AI the context.
